observations: A single fixed take progresses from mostly closed curtains and a darker room through continuous hand and arm action to fully spread curtains and direct light.
Body position, curtain folds, window geometry, and light direction remain continuous; there is no embedded montage, typography, border, watermark, or transition.
The source contains a visible before state, causal action, light-arrival state, and settled consequence without requiring reverse, retime, freeze, zoom, or synthetic coverage.
